lucid-flyway.description: Reworked welcome messaging to flow through the notification service instead of a direct email step. This reflects the production architecture where the onboarding workflow emits an event and the notification service sends both email and in-app guidance.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^event[Publish onboarding.completed event] C^notify[Notification service] C^inapp[Show in-app setup guide] C^event --> notify C^notify --> welcome C^notify --> inapp C^inapp --> ready U^email[Send welcome email]^welcome[Send welcome email] U^flags --> email^flags --> event U^email --> ready^welcome --> ready
